summary: Preserved candidate PR 2167 at 40a488defc20fc508eb9f5d4e099ae869d2cbd9f and corrected two independently reproduced gaps: FP16 all-NaN rows are now finite before sampling, and speculative verification reduces full-NaN rows to a per-request mask handled by the existing request-scoped cleanup path.

tests.what_was_measured: At the exact candidate implementation, AMD Instinct MI355X FP16 logits became all -inf and softmax remained non-finite. See raw/candidate-fp16-gpu.txt.
The unmodified candidate's six tests passed, demonstrating that its regression suite missed the FP16 and speculative-containment counterexamples. See raw/candidate-tests.txt.
18 tests and 2 subtests passed after correction, covering dtype-safe sanitization, speculative per-request mask reduction, request marking, and comprehensive cleanup. See raw/passing-focused.txt.
After correction, all three dtypes had a detected full-row mask and finite logits and softmax probabilities. See raw/passing-gpu-dtypes.txt.
Broader serving tests were blocked because meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct is gated and returned HTTP 401. See raw/passing-sampling-mask.txt.
Changed Python sources compiled and the patch had no whitespace errors.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 under HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0; actual 1x163840 GPU tensors were checked before and after the correction.
remaining_limitations: No Kimi-K3 weights, Blackwell SM10x TP=8, multi-node deployment, or transient production NaN source was available.
No live hierarchical-cache storage backend regression was run; safety remains verified through cleanup hooks and release with is_insert=False rather than end-to-end host-cache publication.
The broad sampling-mask serving suite requires gated Meta Llama weights and failed with HTTP 401.
No native source changed, so native rebuilding was not applicable.
